claims.exact_statement: For the reversible two-state CTMC U <-> N started at U, the native equilibrium mass is pi_N=k_f/(k_f+k_u), while native-state occupancy at a fixed sampling time tau is pi_N*(1-exp(-(k_f+k_u)tau)). Scaling both rates by s>0 preserves the full equilibrium distribution and sends fixed-time occupancy to zero as s tends to zero.
assumptions: Two resolved states U and N
The endpoint is occupancy of N at the stated sampling time, not first-passage probability of ever reaching N by that time
claims.status: internally proved exact model statement; generic reversible-CTMC observation and not claimed novel
claims.novelty_boundary: Does not map sequence mutations to barriers or rates and does not establish a new protein-folding mechanism. Direct computational Top7 cooperativity interventions and experimental protein-switch rate design are prior art.

costs.inputs: Requires the two-state assumptions and the rates or their sum for finite-time prediction; equilibrium occupancy alone supplies only their ratio.
costs.experimental: A real candidate requires state-resolved folding kinetics or an acquired barrier/rate estimate, plus a deadline-specific native-structure or activity assay. No experiment was run.

claims.falsifier: A two-state trajectory calculation violating the forward equation or rate-rescaling identity would falsify the mathematical statement. For a real protein, reproducible fixed-time occupancy prediction outside the acquired rate-confidence interval would falsify the model mapping.
claims.next_gate: Test the unpublished-in-nature Top7 packing/cooperativity substitutions predicted by Yadahalli and Gosavi under blinded stopped-flow kinetics and an independent equilibrium/native-structure assay; compare against equal equilibrium-occupancy static-energy designs. Verify the original article's exact substitution set and experimental status first.

claims.exact_statement: For a supplied pseudoknot-free target and fixed thermodynamic model, generic RNA sequence optimization for target Boltzmann probability or ensemble defect is already directly covered by published design methods; the bounded audit found no distinct new algorithm or validated multi-condition cotranscriptional capability.
assumptions: Target structure, sequence constraints, thermodynamic parameters and solution condition are supplied
Objective is target Boltzmann probability or ensemble defect
Novelty claim concerns generic equilibrium sequence optimization
claims.status: primary-literature-supported scoped rejection; multi-condition kinetic optimizer remains UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: Does not rule out a new kinetic objective, robust uncertainty guarantee, or experimentally validated advantage under equal information and cost.

costs.inputs: Target, valid-sequence space, fixed folding model and conditions are supplied by the established methods.
costs.runtime: Published stochastic or local search and repeated partition-function evaluation; no local replay was performed.
costs.experimental: Synthesis, rate acquisition, chemical probing, and reporter validation are excluded from the cited in-silico demonstrations.

claims.falsifier: A material new guarantee or held-out experimental advantage on a frozen kinetic objective would overturn the rejection for that differentiated interface.
claims.next_gate: Specify a multi-condition response vector, acquire trajectory/rate uncertainty, then compare against SamplingDesign, SAMFEO, and equal-information kinetic baselines under matched compute and assay budgets.

claims.exact_statement: If the P2X2 Scheme IX mirror parameter modes are exact generator/output conjugacies, any uniform ATP waveform and permutation-invariant scalar current record has identical law in the two modes, so it cannot label the stronger-coupling flank.
assumptions: The source-reported mirror map conjugates every transition generator for every uniform ATP concentration
Initial distribution and scalar-current emission transform under the same state permutation
No chain-resolved readout or symmetry-breaking intervention is used
claims.status: conditional internal symmetry theorem; source already reports mirror ambiguity; full 24-state conjugacy not independently checked
claims.novelty_boundary: Protocol-level implication only; no new biological mechanism or priority claim.

costs.inputs: Requires the explicit Scheme IX generator, state permutation, input map, prior, and emission vector.
costs.runtime: Finite symbolic conjugacy check; not performed in this audit.
costs.experimental: A symmetry-breaking chain-resolved reporter or calibrated asymmetric perturbation would be a new acquisition cost.

claims.falsifier: Any transition, prior, or emission term that violates the mirror conjugacy under a uniform ATP schedule invalidates the all-protocol no-go.
claims.next_gate: Enumerate all 24 states and verify generator conjugacy; only then design a labeled/chain-specific experiment.
